messages:
ashley.sales: FYI—Arkadia wants to run a POC using a custom BLOOM-2-small variant (third-party quantized weights). They asked: can we host their checkpoint in Redwood hosted API, what's the timeline, and pricing for a 1 month POC with 50 qps bursts and p99 <200ms?

michael.se: Short version: hosted API cannot accept arbitrary external binary weights today. Options:
- Add the model to our catalog (needs license + eng-ml compatibility work) OR
- Run it on Dedicated / Private where customer-provided artifacts are allowed.
Need to know artifact format (safetensors/ggml/hf), quant type (int8/int4), and licensing.

ravi.ml: If it's safetensors + int8 from a 3rd-party quant tool (q4_0/q8_0), we can probably support it on Dedicated after conversion to our runtime format. Caveats: quant conversion often needs calibration and per-layer fixes. Perf will vary; need a small sample model and 100 inference traces to estimate latency/cost.

ashley.sales: Arkadia said: "safetensors, q4_0 via a llama.cpp-style quant tool". They also attached a short license note that looks custom — julia, can you weigh in?

julia.legal: Quick take: BLOOM-2 upstream is Apache-2A? but derivatives / redistributed quantized builds sometimes add extra terms. We need full license text and confirmation from Arkadia that they have redistribution rights (if we add to catalog). If they can't grant redistribution, Hosted catalog is out — Dedicated or Private only. Also we need to know if the customer wants us to store their artifact in our infra (that's a security/legal red flag unless scoped).

ops-bot: model-import-ticket created: #12345 — https://redwood.internal/tickets/12345 (assigned to eng-ml).

michael.se: POC proposal (minimal):
1) Compatibility quick-check: eng-ml runs 1 inference to validate checkpoint (2 business days)
2) Perf run: Dedicated 2x A10 equivalent, 10k tokens test corpus (3 days)
3) Optimize quant profile + KV cache config (1 week)
4) Handover + runbook for Arkadia (2-3 days)
If Arkadia sends artifact + sample traces today we can start step 1 immediately; overall 2-3 weeks calendar.

ashley.sales: Pricing question: rough ballpark for Dedicated POC for 1 month with burst capacity? They want a single month budget to sign off.

michael.se: Ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Dedicated reserved pool (1 month, 2x A10 equiv) ~ $12k–$18k depending on GPU type and support SLA.
- Add-on burst capacity (auto-burst credit) ~ $2k–$5k depending on peak hours.
- Eng onboarding (one-time eng-ml effort) ~ $4k–$8k professional services if we need porting/quant conversion.
If they can use a model already in our public catalog (no external artifacts), hosted pricing is far lower.

ravi.ml: Technical notes to set expectations:
- To hit p99 <200ms we likely need batching window ~10ms, prefix caching for common prompts, and token limits (max 512).
- Int8 quant may increase throughput but p99 depends on KV cache hitrate and request shape.
- We should test their real prompt distribution rather than synthetic.

ashley.sales: Security ops + compliance asks: Arkadia wants us to sign NDA and run their security questionnaire. They also asked whether we store customer model artifacts in our infra and what controls are in place.

julia.legal: We can sign an NDA. For storing artifacts:
- Hosted product: we don't accept third-party binary model weights into the hosted catalog.
- Dedicated/Private: we can store artifacts per-customer with controls (KMS, restricted access, audit logs). Private is best for reg/compliance or if Arkadia needs GovCloud.
Please attach their security questionnaire here and I'll route to security.

ashley.sales: Pasting the excerpt they sent: "Do you allow storage of customer-provided model artifacts in your infra? Y/N — If yes, describe encryption, access controls, and retention policy."

michael.se: Answer to paste to customer (draft): "Yes — in Dedicated and Private modes only. Artifacts are encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys (optional), access is limited to a named service account and a small set of ops engineers, and retention is configurable. We provide audit logs for all operations. Hosted catalog does not accept external checkpoints. I'll flag for Security to provide the formal writeup."

ravi.ml: For eng-ml: ask Arkadia to provide:
- sample safetensors checkpoint (small) + sha256
- 100 representative requests (prompts + expected output length)
- license text for the particular build
We can run a quick compatibility test within 48 hours once received.

ashley.sales: Arkadia agrees to provide the sample and sec questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. Next steps?

michael.se: I'll start the model-import ticket and ping eng-ml. ravi, can you take the compatibility check if they send the files?

ravi.ml: Yep — I can do it. Please attach artifact to the ticket and mark it "POC: Arkadia".

julia.legal: I'll review the license once uploaded and circle back.

ashley.sales: Thanks — I'll update Arkadia with the POC plan, estimated pricing, and checklist.

michael.se: Action items:
- ashley: collect artifact + 100 traces + sec questionnaire (by EOD tomorrow)
- ashley -> julia: attach license text
- michael -> ops-bot: keep ticket #12345 open and assign eng-ml
- ravi: run compatibility check when files are in

ashley.sales: Sounds good. looping in Arkadia contact (ellie) in DM and will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
